title: Contest
statementMd:
Misha and Vasya participated in a Codeforces contest. Unfortunately, each of them solved only one problem, though successfully submitted it at the first attempt. Misha solved the problem that costs $*a*$ points and Vasya solved the problem that costs $*b*$ points. Besides, Misha submitted the problem $*c*$ minutes after the contest started and Vasya submitted the problem $*d*$ minutes after the contest started. As you know, on Codeforces the cost of a problem reduces as a round continues. That is, if you submit a problem that costs $*p*$ points $*t*$ minutes after the contest started, you get ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e7bb7983e9c15baf66651c7643406c249354c8c1.png) points.

Misha and Vasya are having an argument trying to find out who got more points. Help them to find out the truth.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$, $*d*$ ($250 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 3500$, $0 ≤ *c*, *d* ≤ 180$).

It is guaranteed that numbers $*a*$ and $*b*$ are divisible by $250$ (just like on any real Codeforces round).

## Output

Output on a single line:

"`Misha`" (without the quotes), if Misha got more points than Vasya.

"`Vasya`" (without the quotes), if Vasya got more points than Misha.

"`Tie`" (without the quotes), if both of them got the same number of points.
statementZhMd:
米沙和瓦西亚参加了一场 Codeforces 比赛。遗憾的是，他们每人只解决了一道题，不过都在第一次提交时成功通过了。米沙解决了价值 $*a*$ 分的题目，瓦西亚解决了价值 $*b*$ 分的题目。此外，米沙在比赛开始 $*c*$ 分钟后提交了题目，瓦西亚在比赛开始 $*d*$ 分钟后提交了题目。众所周知，在 Codeforces 上，随着比赛进行，题目的分值会降低。也就是说，如果你在比赛开始 $*t*$ 分钟后提交一道价值 $*p*$ 分的题目，你将获得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e7bb7983e9c15baf66651c7643406c249354c8c1.png) 分。

米沙和瓦西亚正在争论谁获得的分数更多。请帮助他们找出真相。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$ 和 $*d*$（$250 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 3500$，$0 ≤ *c*, *d* ≤ 180$）。

保证 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 都能被 $250$ 整除（与实际的 Codeforces 比赛相同）。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出：

"`Misha`"（不含引号），如果米沙获得的分数高于瓦西亚。

"`Vasya`"（不含引号），如果瓦西亚获得的分数高于米沙。

"`Tie`"（不含引号），如果他们获得的分数相同。
